title: Nominativ & Akkusativ — Subject & Direct Object
explanation: **Nominativ** marks the subject — who or what is doing the action. **Akkusativ** marks the direct object — who or what receives the action. Only the masculine article changes in Akkusativ: **der → den**, **ein → einen**. Feminine, neuter, and plural articles stay the same.

exercises.prompt: Ich sehe ___ Mann. (I see the man.)
Which case answers 'who or what is doing the action'?
Ich habe ___ Hund. (I have a dog.)
exercises.hint: ein → einen in the masculine accusative
